carve.note: The north-west (top) parts of Moskovskaya zastava and Volkovskoye, on the side of Ligovsky prospekt that touches Semyonovsky and Izmaylovskoye, join the merged Semyonovsky-Izmaylovsky area. The cut line is the centerline of the street (dual carriageways collapsed), extended along its end bearings through the rest of the districts; the remainders of 6 and 90 keep their k and share the new edge.

riverCarve.note: The Petrogradsky Island side joins the merged southern area; Krestovsky, Kamenny and Yelagin islands stay together north of the river.

fillFootprintHoles.note: Include enclosed southern land pockets in the walkable territory; municipal boundaries remain unchanged.

cut.note: OSM stops Bolshoy prospekt V.O. about 200 m short of the Gulf shore: the shore strip of Gavan west of it was one face with the south-west tip of Okrug 7, and that face (owned by Okrug 7) dragged the walkable territory of Okrug 7 along the whole west coast. The cut closes the gap.
